tools.name: trnch_register_message
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key for trading, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds.

tools.name: trnch_register
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send the message returned in step 1 and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. The wallet must hold 10 USDC or 0.15 HYPE on Elysium (402 otherwise); 3 keys max per wallet (409); 400 if the signature or message does not match.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_volume, trnch_quote, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_volume, trnch_quote, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
